core.name: Core
core.description: Your base. Serves users, shoots creeps, extends your network. You only go down when every core is down.

server-rack.name: Server Rack
server-rack.description: Forks Processes on a timer. They guard the rack, or gather at its rally point.

gpu-cluster.name: GPU Cluster
gpu-cluster.description: Spins up ranged Inference Drones. Expensive, hits hard. They gather at its rally point.

firewall.name: Firewall
firewall.description: Defensive tower. Shoots any creep in range.

solar-array.name: Solar Array
solar-array.description: Supplies 60 compute: enough to serve a Web App's worth of users. Cheap and fragile.

malware-nest.name: Malware Nest
malware-nest.description: Where the crawlers come from. Shielded while any Botnet Farm stands: break the farms, then take it offline and the whole botnet goes down.

c2-server.name: C2 Server
c2-server.description: Command and control for the botnet. Guards the gateways up to the nest. Knock them down and push in: every few waves the botnet rebuilds them, tougher.

botnet-farm.name: Botnet Farm
botnet-farm.description: The botnet's barracks. Garrisons the fortress with bots. Destroy one and the botnet sends a retaliation wave straight at you, but every farm down makes every later wave smaller.

infected-node.name: Infected Node
infected-node.description: A compromised machine the botnet has taken over. Incidents pour out of it as well as the nest, so the more nodes stand, the more directions you're hit from. Takes 20 seconds to build: clear it and the botnet has to send another infector.

hyperscale-rack.name: Hyperscale Rack
hyperscale-rack.description: Provisions Load Balancers: slow to spin up, very hard to kill. They gather at its rally point.

cdn-edge.name: CDN Edge
cdn-edge.description: Long-range tower. Lighter hits, but it reaches creeps far before they reach you.

power-plant.name: Power Plant
power-plant.description: Supplies 150 compute. Expensive, and a big hole in your capacity if it falls.

web-app.name: Web App
web-app.description: Serves users. More capacity, more revenue, and more to lose when it gets hit.

mesh-node.name: Mesh Node
mesh-node.description: Extends your network a little. Cheap and fragile; build lots.

edge-pop.name: Edge PoP
edge-pop.description: Extends your network a long way. Armored, and priced like it.

function.name: Function
function.description: Keeps a squad of three Lambdas warm. When creeps nearby outnumber the squad (or you scale it up, V), it bursts four more for 20 seconds. Each scale-up costs $.

inference-endpoint.name: Inference Endpoint
inference-endpoint.description: Keeps two ranged Inference Calls warm, and bursts three more when creeps come near. Scale-ups cost more, hit from range. Needs a Data Center.

garden-wall.name: Wall
garden-wall.description: Blocks every path, for creeps and for your own units (put a Gate in it to let them through). Towers shoot over it. Cheap, tough, and the only way to shape where the war goes.

garden-gate.name: Gate
garden-gate.description: A wall your own units (and allies') walk straight through. Creeps and enemies can't: they have to break it.

app-review.name: App Review
app-review.description: A long-range tower. Nothing gets in without approval.

flagship-store.name: Flagship Store
flagship-store.description: Trains Moderators: ranged, sturdy, and happiest behind a wall. They gather at its rally point.

private-cloud.name: Private Cloud
private-cloud.description: Supplies 110 compute, inside your walls where nobody else can reach it.

monorepo.name: Monorepo
monorepo.description: Compiles a Kernel: slow and enormous, it mends every unit and building near it. Needs a Region.

edge-fleet.name: Edge Fleet
edge-fleet.description: Pushes out CDN Swarms three at a time: fast raiders. Needs a Data Center.

mainframe-bay.name: Mainframe Bay
mainframe-bay.description: Rolls out Mainframes: siege iron that tears buildings apart. Needs a Region.

state-machine.name: State Machine
state-machine.description: Keeps one Step Function running, and bursts two more when creeps come near: tough, ranged. Needs a Region.

trust-safety.name: Trust & Safety
trust-safety.description: Trains Gatekeepers: heavy melee that holds a wall gap. Needs a Data Center.

legal-dept.name: Legal Department
legal-dept.description: Retains a Legal Team: ranged, and whatever it hits slows to half speed. Needs a Region.

compute-pool.name: Compute Pool
compute-pool.description: Provisioned concurrency: supplies 90 compute for your warm squads and their bursts.

ci-server.name: CI Server
ci-server.description: Where your army gets better: weapons, armor, and Open Source's unit traits. Select it to research.

rnd-lab.name: R&D Lab
rnd-lab.description: Where your army gets better: weapons, armor, and Hyperscaler's unit traits. Select it to research.

build-pipeline.name: Build Pipeline
build-pipeline.description: Where your army gets better: weapons, armor, and Serverless's unit traits. Select it to research.

design-studio.name: Design Studio
design-studio.description: Where your army gets better: weapons, armor, and Walled Garden's unit traits. Select it to research.
